Will Anderson Jr. and Danielle Hunter still anchor the edges (50 sacks across their first two seasons together), with Derek Stingley Jr. and Kamari Lassiter locking the secondary. DEN.lead: Broncos D/ST stay elite behind Vance Joseph's pressure scheme. Zach Allen and Nik Bonitto lead the rush, Pat Surtain II is still the league's best cover corner, and Talanoa Hufanga sets the tone at safety. LAR.lead: Life after Aaron Donald's 2024 retirement looked like Kobie Turner, Braden Fiske, and Byron Young carrying the front — then L.A. flipped Jared Verse to Cleveland for Myles Garrett in June, and Donald unretired Aug. 30 on a one-year deal. Trent McDuffie and Jaylen Watson remake the secondary. Donald's Week 1 snap count vs SF in Melbourne is still a watch, but the ceiling is DST1 territory when the front is healthy. Set-and-forget if you draft them; don't stream them away.
